newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends firm, CBOT spillover cited.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends firm, CBOT spillover cited.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures ended firm, buoyed by strength in CBOT soybeans and by a lack of hedge pressure, traders said.

"Beans were definitely the driver today, and they managed to pull us higher," a MGE source said. "Also, even though the spring wheat harvest is speeding ahead, our farmers aren't selling so there's no hedge pressure for us."

Further support for MGE spring wheat came as players squared positions and bought their way out of inter-market spreads in which they had been short MGE spring wheat and long KCBT wheat, traders said.
MGE spring wheat ended 1/2 to three cents per bushel higher, with Sept up 1/2 cent at $4.68-1/2. Dec gained 1-1/2 cents to close at $4.65-3/4.
The MGE estimated Tuesday's spring wheat volume at 33.107 million bushels, versus 25.852 million Monday.
Traders said Atwood Peavey bought 1.8 million Dec bushelsand bull-spread 600,000 Sept/Dec bushels at 3-1/2 to four cents.
MGE barley ended 18 to 20 cents per hundredweight lower, with Sept down 18 cents at $7.60. Dec lost 17 cents to close at $7.61.
